text:
Lina: Quick sync — need to align on the marketplace crosswalk for upcoming private-offer renewals + hardware credit offsets. TL;DR: partners want committed spend tiers translated to appliance/HW credits and for that mapping to be reflected in our private-offer terms and the marketplace listing. Who owns timeline and comms?

Sam: Can we split the work by cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure)? Each has different private-offer windows and payout flows. I can own AWS side if someone owns the others.

Maria: Sales + field here — customers care about two things: no interruption to existing discounts, and a clear conversion path for any leftover credits. Recommend 90 days notice before renewal + a 30-day conversion window.

Aj: Engineering note: we can produce a SKU crosswalk and a small mapping table but need canonical SKU list from each cloud + HW partner. Example format I can output:
```
{
  "marketplace_sku": "mp-1234",
  "internal_offer_id": "po-9876",
  "hw_credit_type": "appliance_hours",
  "conversion_rate": "1mp = 0.5ap_hours"
}
```
I'll prototype for AWS once I have SKUs.

Oliver: Finance — we need an impact model: assumed conversion %, breakage, and revenue deferral. For planning, please start with a conservative 20% conversion of committed spend to appliance credits and a 6-month revenue ramp assumption. I can run sensitivity if you give the tier distributions.

Elaine_legal: I can review the private-offer wording + any marketplace T&Cs. Need at least 2 business days per region. Flag any non-standard credit mechanics (e.g., retroactive credits) — those add legal complexity.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing draft uploaded (v2). Link: https://console.marketplace/drafts/po-crosswalk-v2 — review required.

Lina: Proposed owners & timeline: Sam (AWS) / Aj (SKU mapping + implementation) / Maria (field comms + playbook) / Oliver (impact model) / Elaine_legal (terms). Milestones: SKU list by Tue, finance model by Thu EOD, legal signoff Fri, internal announcement next Wed. Meeting to align: Thu 9:30am PT (30m). Please react with :thumbsup: if that works or suggest changes.

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft customer-facing blurb and post to the comms doc: https://docs.internal/marketplace/announce-draft

Aj: I'll start a repo and drop the first CSV by Tuesday. Ping me any SKU gaps.

Oliver: Will slot time to run the sensitivity and post a short deck by Thursday EOD.

Elaine_legal: Looping in regional counsel for EU & APAC. Expect comments within 48 hours after you post the draft.

Lina: Great — thanks all. If anyone can't make Thu 9:30, propose an alternate slot now. Otherwise I'll send calendar invite and the meeting agenda.
